history.germany-impression.0033.all: Impression: devastating, universal, desperate. Six million unemployed by 1932 plus short-time workers; no country hit harder; business collapse after US loans recalled; queues at soup kitchens; Bruning's cuts made him 'hunger Chancellor'; people turned to radical answers.

history.germany-impression.0055.all: Impression: systematic, brutal mass murder on a vast scale. Special SS units with orders to kill Jews and communists; shot beside pits; Babi Yar 30,000 in two days; about half a million killed by end of 1941.

history.germany-impression.0030.all: Impression: a chaotic failure/humiliating fiasco. Hitler's theatrical shot, Bavarian leaders slipped away, police fired and 16 died, Hitler fled and was arrested hiding in an attic.

history.germany-impression.0011.all: Impression: chaos and loss of value of money, with devastating effects on savers/pensioners but benefits for debtors and speculators. Paid twice a day, bread billions of marks, savings worthless, debts paid off cheaply.

history.germany-impression.0047.all: Impression: initially attractive and popular but became compulsory, militaristic and regimented, provoking some boredom and rebellion. Camping/sport, compulsory from 1939, tough soldiers/motherhood, rebellious gangs.

history.germany-impression.0057.all: Impression: war initially barely affected civilians, then hardship after Stalingrad. Surprisingly normal, rationing but plunder, cinemas open; only 1943 rations cut and total war.

history.germany-judgement.0044.all: Plan: Night of the Long Knives June 1934 removed SA/Rohm, won army support, Hitler's reward oath; but also Reichstag Fire Decree, Enabling Act March 1933, banning parties/unions, Gleichschaltung, Hindenburg's death Aug 1934 and merging of offices, oath to Hitler. Judgement: NLK important for army loyalty but Enabling Act more foundational.

history.germany-judgement.0045.all: Plan: Hindenburg's death 2 Aug 1934 allowed Fuhrer combination and army oath, removing last check; but Enabling Act, terror in March 1933 election, Reichstag Fire, banning parties/unions, NLK were earlier and more decisive. Judgement: final step, not decisive.
